- **B05** Enter the number of the three occupants who are under 18. Check your daughter’s date of birth privately.
- **B06–B08 and B18** After the values are restored, join the three name components in the full-name field in the order shown on your passport. If the form requires a different date format, reformat the restored date of birth by hand. If your restored Manchester address includes the postcode, copy it into both postcode boxes and omit it from the address lines.
- **B03, B15–B17, and B25** The property manager or owner supplies the submission methods, identifies the documents requested, and answers the question about pet rules. If you cannot provide current employment or income details, use item 7 to provide other evidence of your ability to pay rent.
- If your wife is also applying, the form requires her to complete a separate application. The occupant total on this application includes all three of you.
